one_line: One repeatable chapter format: a big title word, a skills checklist, a child playing, with comment-for-the-list at the end.

q1_hook.what: 0:00 a toddler on green mats places picture cards on a lotto board, filmed from above. Text: "משחקי קופסה ולמידה" "שאני משחקת בהם עם אחיין שלי בן השנתיים", and below, "בתור מרפאה בעיסוק". No speech. 0:03 the first title, "לוטו".
q1_hook.why: A headline in the first frame states the promise and the credential, over a toddler already playing (T3, H1, H2). The play itself is a motion hook (E1). But it is text and music only, so a viewer with sound on gets no spoken hook (H6, H4).

beats.what: Hook text, then title "לוטו" with three green-check skills; toddler places cards
beats.why: Promise plus the first item at once

beats.what: "סקוצ'י" shape puzzle; "פטריות" pegboard; the toddler looks at the lens at 0:15
beats.why: New toy and title every 4 to 6 s

beats.what: "צלליות" shadow cards; "מר תפוח אדמה" in six quick cuts
"פאזל מגנטי": the toddler sticks animals and vehicles on a whiteboard, with 11 skills
beats.why: Longest chapter, the most visual toy

beats.what: "חרוזים": threading beads on a string, in one calm shot
beats.why: A slower beat before the finish

beats.what: "מה אוכלת החיה?" cards, "פאזל שני חלקים" with a Ravensburger box, "הצבע הראשון שלי" game
beats.why: Three quick items keep the pace

beats.what: A toddler plays with a play kitchen; "רוצות חלק 2 על משחק סימבולי ודמיוני?"; "תעקבו אחרי"
beats.why: Teases a part 2 and asks for the follow

q2_flow.interaction_prompts: On screen at 0:52, "רוצות חלק 2 על משחק סימבולי ודמיוני?", then "תעקבו אחרי". Caption: send to a friend, follow and comment for the list with links, and a question about part 2.
q2_flow.why: The title, checklist and child chapter repeats ten times, so a viewer always knows what comes next (R3, E2). Each item is a toy a parent could buy, so it carries a gift or buy idea to send (R5, R7). The lists are long for 2 to 5 s, and 59 s runs long (R1, R2).

q3_cta.what: On screen 0:52 to 0:58: "רוצות חלק 2 על משחק סימבולי ודמיוני?", "תעקבו אחרי". Caption: "שלחו לחברה...", follow plus "תגיבי לי כאן" for a list of games with links, and a part 2 question.
q3_cta.why: The comment-for-list delivers something real, a list with links (C3, R6). The send ask names a recipient and a reason (C4). But the caption stacks follow, comment, send and a part 2 question (C1), and the on-screen text sits in the lower half, partly under the buttons (C6).

q4_shown.what: A toddler of about 2 playing with about 10 toys in a therapy room on green mats; box art of two games, a Ravensburger puzzle box and a Mr Potato Head box in view; a title and skills for each toy. No price.
q4_shown.why: Each toy is shown in use from the first second (S1). The credential "מרפאה בעיסוק" in the first frame gives authority (S6). A toddler's face is shown throughout, which LumeBook's own Reels should avoid (S5). Most brands are unreadable, so it works as a list, not a sell (H3).

q5_edit.what: 30 shots in 59 s, about 2 s each; straight cuts. Six cuts on "מר תפוח אדמה", an 11.8 s stretch for "פאזל מגנטי". No speed changes seen, no voice, text on screen throughout. Ends on a text end card over play footage.
q5_edit.why: Cuts within one scene every 2 to 5 s match the advised pace (E2), with a change in the first 6 s (E1). The shared layout makes a series easy to follow (R3). With no voice, the text carries it all, so a sound-on viewer gets nothing (E4).

q6_topic.what: A roundup of learning games for a 2-year-old, each with the skills it builds; serves a parent or relative choosing toys for a toddler.
q6_topic.why: A parent of a 2-year-old choosing toys is a real need with a buying moment (K6, K7). Developmental lists are long and strong in tone, but come with a real child at play, which wraps the info in emotion (K4). A reusable list suits save and send (R5, R7).

q7_filmed.what: Handheld phone from the side or above on mats in a therapy room; medium shots of the toddler; a static shot for the beads; a close shot of the vehicles; even daylight; the adult is off camera, only an arm at 0:06 and 0:12.
q7_filmed.why: A real room and a real child look like a creator, not an ad (H8, F7). The toddler stays mid-frame, away from the edges (F2). Toys are small in wide shots and box art is unreadable at phone size (F4). Handheld motion is a little shaky (F7).

q8_text.on_screen: A big bold white title with a black outline per toy, upper third ("לוטו", "סקוצ'י", "פטריות", "פאזל מגנטי", "חרוזים"), then "מפתח:" and a small white list with green check emojis, up to 11 lines, in the middle of the frame, over the child. 0:52 "רוצות חלק 2 על משחק סימבולי ודמיוני?". 0:55 "תעקבו אחרי".
q8_text.caption: "סרטון לגזור ולשמור לפניכן ✂️💾". About 90 words: a save ask, a description of the roundup, a send ask, the list-with-links offer in two steps, a part 2 question, a follow line, a sign-off, 5 hashtags.
q8_text.why: Big title words are readable (T3, T5). The small checklist, 10 to 11 lines in 3 to 11 s, is too long to read at that pace and sits over the child (T2, T5, T4). The caption starts with a save ask, not search words, but names the age and has 5 hashtags (T7).

weak_points: Checklists too long to read in 2 to 5 s and printed over the child; a toddler's face throughout; no voice; asks stacked in the caption; most toy brands unreadable; 59 s.
lumebook_takeaway: Copy the chapter format with books only: a big title word, three short check lines, a hands-only page turn, with one comment-for-the-list ask.
not_verified: Whether music plays (transcript only "תודה רבה"). Whether the child is her nephew, as the text says. Brand names of most toys; a Ravensburger logo is on one box. Whether any toy is sponsored (none marked). No corrections to the coded file. Lead fix 18 Oct: hook_type "child_using_it" (a topic label) replaced by "product_reveal".
